title: 👸 Welcome to Secrets of Elsinore!
body: Thanks for joining the world of Elsinore. Here's a little something to get you started. Don't forget to check out our Discord server for some help and community. The link is in the side panel of the game.

title: 👸 Just another day in Elsinore!
body: Don't forget to enjoy the day :)

title: 🎁 Welcome back to Elsinore!
body: You came back, and Elsinore is glad of it. Here is a gift for your second day. Constable Elbow, the Shepherd and Kent all have more for you.

title: 👑 A Gift from the Queen
body: Queen Gertrude is awake, and the first of Prospero's spells is broken. She sends her thanks, and this. The rest of Elsinore's story opens now: Constable Elbow has more to ask of you.

title: 📦 Caravan Trade Complete!
body: Your settlement filled all Caravan orders. Great teamwork! Here's your reward.

title: 🌾 Harvest Fair Complete!
body: Your settlement filled all Harvest Fair orders. Great teamwork! Here's your reward.

title: 🙏 Thank You for Your Purchase!
body: Here are the items you purchased from the Store.

title: 🗓️ Season Reward!
body: For the top 3 players across the Frontier last season.

title: 🗓️ Season Reward!
body: For all players in the top Settlement last season.

title: 🗓️ Season Reward!
body: CONGRATULATIONS! You were the top player across the Frontier last season!

title: 👸 Thanks for playing Secrets of Elsinore!
body: We're so glad you're spending time with us. Here are some sweets to show our appreciation.

title: 😢 Our bad!
body: We recently had some technical issues. Thanks for your patience.

title: 📣 Release Notes
body: Phase 0 of the big update is live. The Outpost has been retired; anything you had listed there was returned to your warehouse, and any money owed to you was paid. Use the Trade Stall and Global Market to sell. The game stays up while we work; a short maintenance window is coming, and we will announce it here and on the login screen.

title: 🐄 Animal Stalls retired
body: Farm animals no longer need an Animal Stall: they are ready to collect right where they graze. Your Animal Stalls have been removed, and here is what you spent building them.

title: 🧞‍♀️ A Letter from the Oracle
body: "If that which is lost be found": so the prophecy runs, and the crown that was lost is found. Hope stirs. Seek next the old gods' trident, asleep in a sealed shrine. Only a key of bone will wake it, and a brother sworn to vengeance keeps that key.

title: 🧞‍♀️ A Letter from the Oracle
body: The trident wakes, and the sea remembers its gods. Seek next a pale lord of the night who craves quiet among the dead. Put his restless neighbours to rest, and he may bleed for thee.

title: 🧞‍♀️ A Letter from the Oracle
body: The blood is given, and the dead lie quiet. Seek next a bell that rings truest when bought with a secret. Win the deepest trust of the lady of laws, then carry what she whispers to the one she despises.

title: 🧞‍♀️ A Letter from the Oracle
body: The bell has rung, and its echo reached me on my mountain. Seek next the fire that dies and rises again. Only the boldest blade will pluck a feather from its ash.

title: 🧞‍♀️ A Letter from the Oracle
body: The feather is plucked, and still the bird will rise. Seek next a light that burns at the bottom of the burning lake, past a mirror, the black fog and the hound with three heads. The queen of witches can light thy way.

title: 🧞‍♀️ A Letter from the Oracle
body: The brief candle burns in thy hand, and no wind shall put it out. One treasure remains. Where the mountains close like a fist, an old master of storms keeps his counsel. Do as he bids.

title: 🧞‍♀️ A Letter from the Oracle
body: All that was lost is found. Bring the seven treasures to me on Hope Mountain, and Hope shall be thine.
